name: digital-product-studio-marketplace
title_zh: 26 个数字产品技能，装一个市场全带走
tagline_zh: 不用逐个找插件。为 Sadé 的 Digital Product Studio 定制。
tagline_en: No more hunting plugins. Built for Sadé's Digital Product Studio: install once, get 26 specialized skills from.
desc_en: Codex plugin marketplace for Digital Product Studio by Sadé, with 26 specialized digital-product creation skills.
why_zh: 它是技能货架，不是单个工具。26 个技能彼此咬合，覆盖数字产品全流程，省去你拼凑不同插件。
why_en: It's a shelf, not a single tool. 26 interlocking skills span the whole digital-product pipeline, saving you from patching.
limit_zh: 只适配 Sadé 的 Digital Product Studio 环境，非该生态用户装了也用不上。
limit_en: Only works inside Sadé's Digital Product Studio; for digital goods (ebooks, templates, courses), not physical products or coding; requires Codex.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
